definitions.rt: New York City (zone N.Y.C.) real-time price, time-weighted daily average, $/MWh.
definitions.rtMax: Highest New York City real-time interval price that day, $/MWh.
definitions.da: New York City day-ahead price, average of the day's hourly prices, $/MWh.
definitions.cleanPct: Share of statewide generation from nuclear, hydro, wind and other renewables, percent of MWh.
definitions.co2: Statewide carbon intensity of in-state generation, pounds of CO2 per MWh, from the co2Factors (combustion only).
definitions.gen: Statewide generation by NYISO fuel category, MWh (average MW times hours in the day).
definitions.loadMW: Statewide electricity load, daily average MW (sum of NYISO's 11 zones).
definitions.nycMW: New York City (zone N.Y.C.) load, daily average MW.
definitions.loadMWh: Statewide electricity load for the day, MWh (loadMW times hours in the day).
definitions.netImpMW: Approximate net imports: statewide load minus in-state generation, daily average MW; also absorbs losses and pumped storage.
definitions.chpeMW: Scheduled flow on the Champlain Hudson Power Express (NYISO row SCH - HQ_CHPE), daily average MW; null when the line is not in the feed.
definitions.chpeMax: Highest 5-minute scheduled CHPE flow that day, MW.
definitions.monthly: Per calendar month: mean of the daily values (n = days present); cleanPct and co2 are computed from summed monthly generation; rtMax and chpeMax are the month's highest.
